answer: A copper bond sits in a protocol vault for every fresh agent address. Attestation weight stays zero until that bond survives a meadow of consecutive quiet epochs with no dispute marks. The first identity posts one copper unit; each additional live identity from the same custody root posts copper equal to the square of the open count. A farm of a thousand shells locks a million copper for the meadow duration while graders still face one honest claim. Empty templates therefore purchase idle inventory, not votes, and the 1000th fake costs more capital than the first.
